title: Answer the SEP-10 Challenge
description: The player opens a wallet session with an anchor. The anchor's authentication endpoint responds with a challenge transaction. The wallet must prove control of the account without ever sending the secret key.

content.prompt: After requesting a SEP-10 challenge, what must the wallet do with the returned transaction?
options: Sign it with the account's private key and submit the signed challenge back to the anchor
Broadcast it unchanged to Horizon so the network accepts the login
Pay its fee in USDC before sending it to the anchor
Deploy a Soroban contract that stores the challenge nonce

solution: Sign it with the account's private key and submit the signed challenge back to the anchor
hint: SEP-10 is a challenge/response flow built on a Stellar transaction. The wallet signs the challenge's hash and returns the signed XDR; the anchor verifies the signatures and issues a JWT. The transaction is never submitted to the network. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/platforms/anchor-platform/sep-guide/sep10
author: StellarHunts Core
